primary_external_evidence.claim: SourceLoader.get_code attempts bytecode-cache read/validation and can execute compiled cached code before source compilation.
Source loaders may support bytecode caches and cache_from_source maps source files to compiled cache paths.
Without an alternate prefix Python reads cache files from source-tree __pycache__; a pycache prefix changes both read and write location.

r1_hypothesis.hypothesis: Pre-attesting only the .py source chain is not sufficient to establish all Python admission-code bytes when a valid pre-existing local .pyc cache is present.
r1_hypothesis.causal_mechanism: SourceLoader may return validated cached bytecode before reading/compiling the root-attested .py source; therefore executable bytes can originate from __pycache__ rather than the attested source inode.
r1_hypothesis.predicted_if_right: A valid local cache can be selected as the code object for an imported guard even though the matching .py file passed ownership/link-shape checks.
r1_hypothesis.predicted_if_wrong: SourceLoader always compiles the checked source under the current launcher and never reads local bytecode caches.
